title: game/data/nodeTypes.json: the kinds of node on a run's map (roguelite track RL-6; logic/run-map.js)

name.description: what the player reads (the map's pins, the forecast)

place.description: RL-S2: the word its place's name ends with, when it isn't the type's name (a rival's place is a Route: "Thicket Route")

mark.description: its marker on the run map: an outline of logic/run-marks.js RUN_MARK_TYPES (the type's id when left out)

engine.description: how it plays: scene (a walkable map) or menu (a story script or a shop sheet, RL-12)

layout.description: RT-1: its place is laid out as a route (logic/mapgen.js MAPGEN_LAYOUTS, a plan drawn from rules.json run.layouts by its biome); a town, a waystation and a stall keep their open ground

shop.description: RL-12b: it sells things (a town, a stall): never two of them one after the other on a run's map

chance.description: RL-14: instead of a weight: the chance a free node becomes this type (a scrapyard), drawn on a stream of its own so every other node keeps its type

fromRow.description: RL-14: with a chance, only from this map row on (a scrapyard waits for the middle rows); left out: any row

weight.description: how often it fills a free row (rows rules.json run.map gives no role); 0 or left out: never
